title: What the Road Took
summary: A caravan went quiet three days ago on the Old Road. A survivor reached Brightfall before collapsing. The Wanderers Guild wants to know what happened. So do the bandits who made it happen.

phases.label: Find the caravan survivor at the Brightfall inn

onComplete.text: The survivor, a junior guild courier named Temm, is coherent enough to describe the attack. Twisted Hand bandits, eight or more, stopped the caravan at the bridge ford. The cargo — sealed guild packets — was taken rather than destroyed. That detail is the one that matters.

phases.label: Follow the trail from the ford to the bandit camp

onComplete.text: The trail is not well hidden. The Twisted Hand did not expect to be followed — or did not care. The camp is in a collapsed mill two hours east of the ford. Eight people, the guild packets, and something else that should not be there: an Ashen Veil brand burned into the mill's main post.

phases.label: Confront the Twisted Hand — rescue, ransom, or eliminate

onComplete.text: The guild packets are recovered. The Ashen Veil connection to the Twisted Hand is a lead worth keeping.
